# axual_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up a Cluster by name, for example to add an existing Cluster to an `axual_instance`. Broker credentials are not exposed.

## Platform Manager version
- Platform Manager 16.0.0 or later.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The exact name of the Cluster.

### Read-Only

- `bootstrap_urls_by_authentication` (Map of String) The bootstrap servers applications use, per authentication method.
- `description` (String) The description of the Cluster.
- `group_pattern` (String) How a consumer group id is made on the Cluster.
- `id` (String) Cluster unique identifier
- `kafka_version` (String) The Kafka version of the Cluster.
- `location` (String) Where the Cluster runs.
- `provider_type` (String) `apache-kafka` or `strimzi`.
- `shared` (Boolean) Whether the Cluster is shared by all tenants.
- `topic_pattern` (String) How a topic name is made on the Cluster.
- `transactional_pattern` (String) How a transactional id is made on the Cluster.

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "axual_cluster" "existing" {
  name = "alpha"
}

resource "axual_instance" "test" {
  name       = "Test"
  short_name = "test"
  clusters   = [data.axual_cluster.existing.id]
}
```
